LESSON: MUSICAL RESPONDING

Grade: PP1
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: LISTENING AND
Topic 10.1: Musical RESPONDING

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Musical RESPONDING. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Identify various sound 5 Lessons from the environment for familiarization
2. Sing songs related to musical sounds made by animals in the environment for enjoyment. 102
3. Appreciate various musical sound made by animals

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. Identify various sound 5 Lessons from the environment for familiarization
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to identify various sound 5 Lessons from the environment for familiarization. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. Sing songs related to musical sounds made by animals in the environment for enjoyment. 102
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to sing songs related to musical sounds made by animals in the environment for enjoyment. 102. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. Appreciate various musical sound made by animals
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate various musical sound made by animals. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Musical RESPONDING.
2. Explain Musical RESPONDING to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: Learners identify various sounds did you like most? from the environment for from the environment. familiarization
4. Show that you can: Identify various sound 5 Lessons from the environment for familiarization
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Musical RESPONDING. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Musical RESPONDING important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS
